areas.name: Mitte / Alexanderplatz
areas.why: The bus stops on Alexanderstrasse, opposite the Park Inn. Most Mitte hotels are a walk or one short U-Bahn hop away.
areas.move: Get off here and walk. For hotels toward Hackescher Markt, the M4 or M5 tram leaves from Alexanderplatz.
areas.zob: U-Bahn from U Kaiserdamm, about 300 m from the platforms, toward the city centre. Around 30 minutes to Alexanderplatz.

areas.name: Around Hauptbahnhof
areas.why: The Invalidenstrasse stop is right by the main station, so hotels around Hauptbahnhof and Europacity are on foot.
areas.move: Get off at Hauptbahnhof and walk, or ride one S-Bahn stop where needed.
areas.zob: S-Bahn from S Messe Nord/ZOB one stop to Westkreuz, then any east-bound S-Bahn to Hauptbahnhof. About 20 minutes.

areas.name: City West / Kudamm
areas.why: The Zoologischer Garten stop puts you in the middle of City West, a short walk from Kudamm and the Memorial Church.
areas.move: Get off at Zoo and walk. Most City West hotels are within ten minutes on foot.
areas.zob: U-Bahn from U Kaiserdamm to Zoologischer Garten, about 8 minutes, or the M49 or X34 bus from Messedamm.

areas.name: Kreuzberg
areas.why: For eastern Kreuzberg around Wrangelkiez and Goerlitzer Park, Ostbahnhof is just across the Spree.
areas.move: Get off at Ostbahnhof, cross the Schillingbruecke, and you are in Kreuzberg. For Bergmannkiez, Suedkreuz plus the Ring works better.
areas.zob: U-Bahn from U Kaiserdamm toward Moeckernbruecke, then the U7 one or two stops. Around 30 minutes depending on your corner.

areas.name: Neukoelln
areas.why: From Suedkreuz the Ring S-Bahn runs three stops east to Hermannstrasse and Neukoelln station.
areas.move: Get off at Suedkreuz and take the S41 or S46 toward Neukoelln, under ten minutes.
areas.zob: S42 from S Messe Nord/ZOB straight to Neukoelln, no change, 23 minutes.

areas.name: Prenzlauer Berg
areas.why: From the Alexanderplatz stop the U2 reaches Senefelderplatz and Eberswalder Strasse in a few minutes, and the M1 tram covers Kastanienallee.
areas.move: Get off at Alexanderplatz, then U2 toward Pankow, about 9 minutes to Schoenhauser Allee.
areas.zob: S41 from S Messe Nord/ZOB straight to Schoenhauser Allee, no change, 17 minutes.

areas.name: Friedrichshain
areas.why: Ostbahnhof sits on the edge of Friedrichshain. Warschauer Strasse is one S-Bahn stop or a short walk along the East Side Gallery.
areas.move: Get off at Ostbahnhof and walk, or ride one stop to Warschauer Strasse.
areas.zob: S-Bahn from S Messe Nord/ZOB via Westkreuz to Warschauer Strasse. About 30 minutes.

areas.name: Schoeneberg
areas.why: Suedkreuz sits in southern Schoeneberg with the Ring and mainline station right by the stop. For the northern end around Nollendorfplatz, the Zoologischer Garten stop plus two U-Bahn stops also works.
areas.move: Get off at Suedkreuz and take the Ring one stop west to Schoeneberg station, or walk if you stay near the station.
areas.zob: S42 from S Messe Nord/ZOB straight to Suedkreuz, no change, 15 minutes.
